test_title: PYST 25: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 20 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: AHJQ is related to DJMS in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, MPVY is related to PRYA. To which of the given options is VVEE related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, AHJQ is related to DJMS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60f06153882e6fa083ac647bdfbe28e28dd5e6d7c163702fda773a42605e61f8.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa1c4f03c8cf33274e4eb8ae33bbc59fb4f4a6b4dfc4dcfa5719bfddd41a8e50.png] 

For, MPVY is related to PRYA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04bb7fdeaf14e17997235e2e9f7a0cdad5735af07101e780340cb8f950c46595.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d0bb6734f8c3238649d914896303366cc5573a8e64e7798714ff6d7996ad8df.png] 

Similarly, for **VVEE**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9005d95cfbd49ee168038d4f30737c961b2fb1a8bceebb76e58a681a8eb276a9.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f57a687ed8acbce2ca32e8a25563555396e60c431972f3348f109428aaf45bb1.png] 

So, VVEE will be written as **YXHG**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
